Weekday-date pairs agree with each other (Thursday March 20 with Saturday March 22; Thursday June 12 with Saturday June 14; Monday June 9 and 16) and match the 2025 calendar; no year appears on the page, so this is harmless, though r-p7-01 to 03 match 2026 if the batch is meant to share one year. No internal inconsistencies and no option defensible as a second answer.
